categories.title: Base pack
categories.blurb: Not up for vote. These make the game run better and easier, and most of them are invisible in play.

categories.title: Factories & power
categories.blurb: The industrial core. Create is the mechanical one (cogs, belts, steam), the others add electricity, cables and big machines.

categories.title: Mining & drilling
categories.blurb: Ways to dig out ore without spending every evening with a pickaxe. Create, Mekanism and Immersive Engineering each bring their own drill or miner too.

categories.title: Guns & combat
categories.blurb: Two solid choices. Vote for the one you'd rather have, not both.

categories.title: Quality of life & world
categories.blurb: Small additions that make a friends server nicer. All light.

categories.title: Building and decoration
categories.blurb: Extra blocks for making your base look good. No machines, no new mobs, nothing that changes how the game plays.

categories.title: Animals
categories.blurb: New animals out in the world: birds, deer, otters, ducks, bugs and more. Each one gives your PC more creatures to draw, so on a slow PC they cost a little speed.

categories.title: Bosses & trials
categories.blurb: Not up for vote. Big fights in dungeons out in the world, and wave fights you open yourself. Bosses drop their own gear; seasons count who beat what.

categories.title: On the server only
categories.blurb: Runs on the server, nothing to install on your PC.

mods.name: Create
mods.description: Cogs, belts, steam engines, trains, mechanical drills and presses. The heart of the pack.

videos.title: MINECRAFT CREATE MOD, FOR DUMMIES | lesson 1
3 Early Game Create Mod Farms You NEED in your World
Why Create is the Best Minecraft Mod Ever Made

mods.howTo:
Start with a **water wheel** next to flowing water and a **shaft**: anything on the shaft turns. Make **andesite alloy** (andesite + iron nugget) for shafts, cogwheels and the **mechanical press**. Next: a press over a belt for automatic plates, a millstone for flour and dyes.

In JEI, hold **W** over any Create block to watch its Ponder animation; the **Engineer's Goggles** show speed and stress when you look at a machine.

keys.does: Ponder: hold over a block in JEI

mods.name: Create: Crafts & Additions
mods.description: Adds electricity to Create: motors, generators, wires and a few gadgets.

videos.title: Create Crafts & Additions Guide: Electric Motor and all mechanics
This mod makes Create Better with Electricity and More
Which Electricity Addon for Create is Right For You?

mods.howTo: Turns Create's rotation into electricity. Put an **alternator** on a spinning shaft, run **copper wire** (spools) from its connector to a machine's connector, and it has power. **Electric motors** turn power back into rotation; **accumulators** store it. One water wheel can't turn an alternator on its own: put several on the same shaft.

mods.howTo: Build a cannon from a **cannon mount** and barrel blocks, load a shell and powder charges with a deployer or by hand, then fire it with redstone. Ponder (hold **W** over a block in JEI) shows each step.

mods.name: Immersive Engineering

Early on: a **coke oven** for coal coke, a **water wheel** or **windmill** with **LV wire** to power machines, then the multiblocks shown in the manual, built and finished with the **Engineer's Hammer**.

mods.name: Mekanism

mods.name: Sophisticated Backpacks

mods.howTo: Craft a **backpack** (leather and a chest) as soon as you can. Wear it in the chest slot and press **`** (the key left of 1) to open it, or hold it and right-click. Upgrade it later (iron, gold, diamond, netherite) and put upgrades in its side slots: **Pickup** collects items for you, **Magnet** pulls them in, **Crafting** gives a crafting grid inside.

mods.name: Quarry (Additional Enchanted Miner)
mods.description: Mark out an area and a framed quarry mines everything inside it down to bedrock, into a chest or pipe. Needs power.

videos.title: Minecraft Quarry Plus - Full Beginners Guide (For Forge)
How To Build an AUTOMATIC Mining System In Minecraft (Quarry Mod Guide)
Minecraft Quarry Plus - Complete Guide Forge

mods.howTo: Place **markers** at the corners of the area to dig and right-click one to link them. Put the **quarry** next to the marked area, give it power (Crafts & Additions wires work) and a chest or pipe next to it for the output. It digs everything inside down to bedrock. It needs real power to dig fast: one small generator only crawls. **Wind generators** built high up are the easiest real power. **Unbreaking** makes it cheaper to run; **Efficiency** makes it hungrier, not faster. It stops when its storage is full and starts again when there is room.

mods.name: Quarry pause
mods.description: Our own small addition to the quarry, on the server only: a quarry stops digging while its chest is full and starts again by itself when there is room.

mods.howTo: Guns, ammo and attachments are crafted at the **gun smith table**. Pistols, revolvers, double barrels and bolt rifles take iron; most rifles, SMGs and shotguns also take **steel**; the biggest guns need **netherite** and **refined obsidian** too. Hold right-click to aim, left-click to shoot, **R** to reload, **Z** for attachments (scopes, grips, silencers). Melee and scope zoom have no key in this pack (V is voice chat); set them in Options → Controls → TaCZ if you want them.

mods.name: Farmer's Delight

videos.title: Pipez Complete Mod Tutorial

Pipez mod - Minecraft 1.18+ Bit-By-Bit

mods.howTo: Place a pipe against a chest or machine; one pipe each for items, fluids, energy and gas. Right-click a pipe's end with the **wrench** to choose whether it pulls out of or pushes into the block. Add filters and speed upgrades in the end's menu.

mods.name: Let's Do Meadow
mods.description: The mountain meadow made cosy: water buffalo and new cattle, milk and cheese-making, alpine flowers, pine wood, new wool and rustic furniture.

Minecraft: LET'S DO MEADOW MOD | Minecraft Mods Showcase 1.20.1+

mods.howTo: Go up to a **meadow** biome (high grass and flowers in the mountains) for its animals, flowers and alpine salt. Make cheese with a **cheese form**; JEI shows each step (search `@meadow`). A **woodcutter** saws logs for you: place it, use an axe on it, then put logs in.

mods.name: Let's Do Vinery

Press grapes or apples in an **apple press** for juice, then put it in a **fermentation barrel** to make wine; wine gets better as it ages. JEI shows every wine (search `@vinery`).

For a **hammock**, put up two **rope and nails** facing each other and place the hammock between them; lie in it by day to skip to the night.

mods.name: Create: Connected
mods.description: More parts for Create machines: a kinetic battery that stores rotation, item silos and fluid vessels, more gearboxes and clutches, linked buttons and levers, and catalysts that give fans new jobs.

videos.title: These Features Should Be Added to Create Mod! - Create Connected
This Addon Fixed Create.
Create: Connected || Mod Tutorial

mods.howTo: Extra parts for Create, crafted like Create's own (JEI shows each one, search `@create_connected`). The **kinetic battery** stores rotation for later; the **item silo** and **fluid vessel** are a vault and a tank in other shapes; a **shear pin** or **overstress clutch** cuts a line before it overloads; an **empty fan catalyst** filled with a material gives an encased fan a new job. Hover over a part and hold **W** for Create's how-to scene where there is one.

mods.name: Create: The Factory Must Grow
mods.description: Heavy industry for Create: coke ovens and blast furnaces for steel, oil pumped up and refined into fuel, big engines, concrete, aluminium and plastic, and grenades and napalm.

videos.title: Create: TFMG 1.0 Update - Comprehensive Tutorial (1.0.1b)
Cast Iron, Coal Coke, and Steel || Getting started with Create: The Factory Must Grow
Minecraft Create: The Factory Must Grow - Mod Showcase

mods.howTo: **Steel:** a **coke oven** turns coal into coal coke and creosote (slowly, so build a row). A **blast stove** burns the creosote into hot air for a **blast furnace**: a ring of fireproof bricks round a blast furnace output, with a hatch and reinforcements. Drop raw or crushed iron and **limesand** in the top and cast the molten steel into ingots in a **casting basin**. **Oil:** run industrial pipes down to a deposit, put a **pumpjack** on top and refine it in a **distillation tower**. **Engines** of up to five blocks burn the fuel for rotation. Lead, nickel and steel from any mod work in its recipes. Hover over a machine and hold **W** for its how-to scene.

Bone meal on most of them drops a copy. Craft a **Bloom Basket** from 3 planks, 1 dirt and 3 sticks to plant Pansies in.

mods.name: Fairy Lights
mods.description: Strings of lights to hang between fences and walls: fairy lights, lanterns, bulbs, stars, hearts and more, in any colour, plus pennant bunting, tinsel and garlands.

videos.title: Fairy Lights Mod Review
minecraft mods you NEED to try out in 2025 | part 1 - fairy lights

mods.howTo: Craft **hanging lights** from an iron ingot, string and an iron ingot in a row, with up to eight lights in the other slots (each light is crafted too: JEI shows them, search `@fairylights`). Glowstone dust on a light makes it twinkle. Hold the hanging lights, right-click a fence or wall, then right-click another one to hang the string. Right-click the string to switch it on or off; string makes it hang lower, a stick tighter.

mods.name: Amendments
mods.description: Small upgrades to vanilla blocks: lanterns that hang on walls and swing, carpet on stairs and slabs, stacked cakes, skull piles and candle skulls, cauldrons that mix potions and dyes, and jukeboxes that show their disc.

videos.title: Amendments Mod Showcase - Minecraft Mod for 1.20.1

mods.howTo: Mostly it just works. Place any lantern against a wall to hang it there. Put carpet on stairs or slabs. Place a cake on a cake. A cauldron holds any liquid: mix dyes or potions in it, and use an item on it to dye or tip it. Hanging signs can hold an item on each side.

mods.name: Twigs
mods.description: Little natural details and new stone: pebbles, twigs and seashells, paper lanterns, lamps, wooden tables, bamboo thatch, and new rocks (rhyolite, schist, bloodstone) with bricks, slabs and stairs.

mods.howTo: Pebbles, twigs and seashells lie about on the ground in new land: pick them up and place them as decoration. Craft **tables**, **paper lanterns** and **lamps** at a crafting table, and cut the new stones into bricks, slabs and stairs at a stonecutter. JEI lists everything (search `@twigs`).

mods.name: Naturalist
mods.description: Lots of wildlife, each in the biomes it belongs in: deer, bears, birds, butterflies, snails, ducks, hedgehogs, giraffes, hippos, lions and more. Some bite: snakes, alligators, scorpions, sharks and the big cats.

mods.howTo: Animals live where you would expect them: deer and bears in forests, snakes and alligators in swamps, lions, zebras and giraffes in savannas, fish, rays and sharks in the sea. Several can be bred or fed like vanilla animals (a bear loves honeycomb). Take care by water and in swamps: alligators, sharks and piranhas attack. Most of them turn up in land nobody has been to yet. JEI lists what they drop (search `@naturalist`).

mods.name: Critters and Companions
mods.description: Small, gentle animals: otters, ferrets, red pandas, koi, dragonflies, leaf insects, sea bunnies, dumbo octopuses, little snow birds and jumping spiders. Several can be tamed.

Critters and Companions trailer

mods.howTo: **Otters** live in rivers and open clams for pearls (fish clams up in a river). Tame a **ferret** (plains and forests) with raw rabbit, a **red panda** (jungles) with sweet berries, a **dragonfly** (over rivers) with spider eyes and a **shima enaga** (snowy places) with seeds. Pick up koi, sea bunnies and dumbo octopuses with a bucket. A group of koi brings you luck.

mods.name: Friends & Foes
mods.description: The mobs that lost Mojang's mob votes: copper and tuff golems, the moobloom, the glare, crabs, penguins and the rascal. Also a few foes: the iceologer, the illusioner, the mauler, the barnacle and the wildfire.

mods.howTo: A **tuff golem** is a tuff block, a wool block and a pumpkin; give it an item and it holds it up for show. A **copper golem** presses copper buttons and goes green like copper does. Find the **rascal** in a mineshaft three times and it gives you a present. **Crabs** live on beaches and in mangrove swamps, **mooblooms** in flower fields, the **glare** in lush caves. The **wildfire** guards a citadel in the Nether. JEI shows the rest (search `@friendsandfoes`).

mods.name: Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies
mods.description: Crows that land and hop about, moths round your lights and spiders on the walls, just for atmosphere, and very rarely the Hat Man. They are only on your own PC: the server and the other players never see them.

mods.howTo: Nothing to do: the crows, moths and spiders come and go around you by themselves, and you can't catch them. Don't want the Hat Man (a shadowy figure that is gone when you look)? Main menu → **Mods** → **Cosy Critters** → **Config**, and switch off **Spawn Hat Man**. The same screen sets how many birds, moths and spiders there are.

mods.name: Server Sided Portals
mods.description: Walk-through portals to Ashmoon, a moon of its own for mining. Nothing to install: it runs on the server.
mods.howTo: Build a frame of **smooth basalt** shaped like a nether portal (smelt basalt to get it) and right-click inside it with an **eye of ender**. Step in to reach **Ashmoon**: everything can be mined there, and osmium and the other Mekanism ores are found only there. Gravity is low, so you jump high and fall slowly; the night never ends, monsters are about, and beds explode. Below y 30 there is **radiation**, worse the deeper you go: wear a **gas mask** (leather, 2 string, charcoal, glass pane) or a hazmat mask. Below y -25 it kills: wear a **full hazmat suit**. A portal comes out at the same spot on the other side; walk back through it to come home.
